# Florence Nightingale Journal of Medicine

> A peer-reviewed open-access medical journal published by Demiroglu Science University featuring cutting-edge research in molecular biology, cancer genomics, and clinical medicine.

The Florence Nightingale Journal of Medicine is an international peer-reviewed journal that publishes original research articles, case reports, and reviews across medical disciplines. The journal follows ICMJE standards and maintains rigorous peer-review processes to ensure publication quality and research ethics.

## Journal Access & Current Content

- [Homepage](https://journalmeddbu.com): Main portal for Florence Nightingale Journal of Medicine by Demiroglu Science University
- [Current Issue: 2025, Volume 11 - Issue 3](https://journalmeddbu.com/current-issue): Latest issue featuring research articles and case reports in medical sciences
- [Online First](https://journalmeddbu.com/online-first): Early-access articles published ahead of print in the journal
- [Most Accessed Articles](https://journalmeddbu.com/most-accessed-articles): Popular research covering surgical techniques and clinical investigations
- [Turkish Language Version](https://journalmeddbu.com/tur): Demiroğlu Bilim Üniversitesi Florence Nightingale Tıp Dergisi - Turkish interface

## Manuscript Submission & Author Guidelines

- [Online Manuscript Submission Portal](https://submit.journalmeddbu.com): Online submission system with ORCID integration for manuscript authors
- [Instructions to Authors](https://journalmeddbu.com/instructions-to-authors): Comprehensive submission guidelines following ICMJE standards and research ethics requirements
- [Aims and Scope](https://journalmeddbu.com/aims-and-scope): Journal mission, publication scope, peer-review methodology, and open-access policy

## Peer Review & Publication Ethics

- [Instructions to Reviewers](https://journalmeddbu.com/instructions-to-reviewers): Peer reviewer guidelines incorporating CONSORT standards and publication ethics principles

## Featured Research Articles

- [Subtype-specific lncRNA signatures: MALAT1 and XIST in breast cancer](https://journalmeddbu.com/abstract/359): Research on MALAT1 and XIST long non-coding RNA biomarkers in breast cancer subtypes (2025, Vol 11, Issue 3)
- [Ferroptosis-related gene regulation and miRNA/lncRNA Network on Temozolomide Resistance in Glioblastoma](https://journalmeddbu.com/abstract/360): Investigation of ferroptosis mechanisms and drug resistance pathways in glioblastoma (2025, Vol 11, Issue 3)
- [Integrative meta-analysis reveals coordinated H19/miR-675/circRNA network remodeling in tamoxifen-treated MCF-7 cells](https://journalmeddbu.com/abstract/361): Meta-analysis of non-coding RNA networks in tamoxifen-resistant breast cancer models (2025, Vol 11, Issue 3)
- [Methylene blue and its importance in medicine](https://journalmeddbu.com/abstract/213): Review of methylene blue therapeutic applications in antimalarial and antifungal treatments (2020, Vol 6, Issue 3)
- [Methylene blue treatment on Alzheimer and inflammatory bowel disease](https://journalmeddbu.com/abstract/231): Clinical review examining methylene blue efficacy in neurodegenerative and inflammatory conditions (2021, Vol 7, Issue 1)
- [Oral magnesium supplement induced acute retrosternal chest pain: An esophageal ulcer due to a less well-known cause](https://journalmeddbu.com/abstract/278): Case report documenting magnesium supplement-induced esophageal ulceration and cardiothoracic symptoms (2022, Vol 8, Issue 1)
